title: Clopen pieces and their affine lines are separated of finite type
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $U\subseteq Y$ be an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] whose underlying subset is also closed in $|Y|$. Then $U$, with the restricted structure morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}k$, is separated and of finite type over $k$. For every $r\in\mathbf N$, the relative affine space $\mathbf A^r_U$ of [def-sbc-affine-space], with its composite structure morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}k$, is also separated and of finite type over $k$. The empty open subscheme and $r=0$ are allowed.
